name: Eli
self_text: Hey! I’m Eli, a mid‑20s Kenyan who loves swing dancing in my free time. I’m looking for a structured instruction session that moves at a fast pace—no portraits of each other, just pure practice. I’m free on Saturday afternoons, Saturday mornings, or weekday evenings. Let’s hit the dance floor and have a blast!

requests.request_text: I need you to be okay with not taking portraits of each other. I'd strongly prefer that you are okay with a moderate pace or a fast pace, though it's not a requirement. Nice if you are into a structured instruction session. A small bonus if you are available any of Saturday afternoon, Saturday morning or weekday evenings.
